description: This file defines the API and data structures for revision walking in a version control system, including revision flags, structures for revision info, and functions for revision management.

methods.name: repo_init_revisions
methods.description: Initializes a rev_info structure with default values, associating it with a repository and optional prefix.

methods.name: setup_revisions
methods.description: Parses revision arguments and fills the rev_info structure accordingly.

methods.name: release_revisions
methods.description: Frees memory allocated in rev_info after revision processing is complete.

methods.name: prepare_revision_walk
methods.description: Prepares rev_info for iteration over revisions; returns error code if any.

methods.name: get_revision
methods.description: Iterates over rev_info, returning the next commit each call, NULL at end.
